data.user_prompt: Where can I buy or get a louvred pergola in Sydney? What are the best options?

sections.text:
If you're looking to purchase a louvred pergola in Sydney, here are some reputable options to consider:

**[Acetech Architectural](https://acetecharch.com.au/?utm_source=openai)**  
**Open now · Construction material wholesaler · 5.0 (51 reviews)**  
_40 Lisbon St, Fairfield East NSW 2165, Australia_  
Offers the AC Series louvred pergolas with motorized louvre blades rotating up to 90 degrees, integrated LED lighting, and optional rain sensors for enhanced outdoor living.

**[Terra Nature Nest](https://terranaturenest.com.au/?utm_source=openai)**  
**Open now · Outdoor furniture store · 5.0 (8 reviews)**  
_Unit 1/200 Fairfield Rd, Yennora NSW 2161, Australia_  
Offers the Terra Classic Modular Louvred Pergola, a modular system designed for fast installation and flexible sizing, built for Australian weather conditions.

**[Ozzy Backyards](https://ozzybackyards.com.au/?utm_source=openai)**  
**Open now · Carport and pergola builder · 5.0 (12 reviews)**  
_40-44 Wellington Rd, South Granville NSW 2142, Australia_  
Specializes in custom louvred pergola systems that blend style, functionality, and durability, with options for motorized outdoor blinds and decking services.

**[Patios Coast2Coast](https://patioscoast2coast.com.au/?utm_source=openai)**  
**Open now · Patio enclosure supplier · 5.0 (59 reviews)**  
_Unit 1/2 Apprentice Dr, Berkeley Vale NSW 2261, Australia_  
Provides opening louvre roof and patio solutions, including insulated and retractable patio roofs, designed to enhance outdoor living spaces.

When selecting a louvred pergola, consider factors such as material quality, design flexibility, warranty, and additional features like motorization or integrated lighting. It's advisable to contact these providers directly to discuss your specific requirements and obtain quotes tailored to your needs.
